## About
J and M Repairs started as a husband and wife operation. The owner and his wife Maria founded the company, and it has grown into a team of skilled, professional electrical technicians who share the same commitment to quality workmanship and customer service.
You'll meet people like Javin, Narciso, Jason and Jose. Every member of our team is carefully selected and background checked. We know your home is a valuable investment, so we treat every property with care.
We're a licensed, bonded and insured electrical company serving residential and commercial customers from Surprise, AZ. Customers have given us a 5 rating across 28 Google reviews.

## Services
- Outdoor/landscape lighting: Wiring and lighting for your yard, patio and the outside of your home, plus lighting design.
- Recessed & Track lighting: We wire for any type of lighting, including recessed and track lighting.
- Installation of ceiling/attic/exhaust fans: Fan installation and fan balancing. We specialize in high ceiling installations.
- Upgraded panel change: Electrical panel upgrades, along with oven and microwave electrical runs.
- Pool/Spa/Jacuzzi wiring: Wiring for your pool, spa or Jacuzzi.
- Troubleshooting: We track down electrical problems and repair them, for homes and businesses.
- Old house wiring: Work on the wiring in older homes.
- Commercial tenant improvement: Electrical work for commercial tenant improvements and remodels.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We service all of your electrical needs, commercial and residential.

Q: Who will be working in my home?
A: One of our electrical technicians or helpers. Every member of our team is carefully selected and background checked.

Q: Can you install a fan I already bought?
A: One reviewer bought a fan from Lowe's and had our team install it, and said we were great from start to finish.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Saturday, 7:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

Q: How do I set up a job?
A: Please contact us to schedule an appointment. Call 623-979-9751 or email jandmrepairsllc@gmail.com.

## What customers say
- "We hired Javin with J & M to run electricity to our 20-foot retractable awnings, and the results were nothing short of exceptional. From the start, it was clear these guys take real pride in their work.

We didn't want unsightly wires running along the fascia or an exterior outlet disrupting the look of our home. J & M came up with a smart, clean solution — routing the line from a ceiling fan inside the house, up through the attic, and out to the awnings completely out of sight. You would never know the wiring is even there.
Their professionalism inside the home was equally impressive. They covered our rugs and furniture before getting started, carefully removed the ceiling fan, did all the wiring, and reinstalled everything perfectly. Not a trace that anyone had been there.

The finished result couldn't look better. No exposed wires, no exterior outlets — just a seamless, polished installation. If you're looking for electricians who are skilled, tidy, and genuinely care about doing the job right, J & M Repairs is the only call you need to make." (Chelly B, 5/5)
